stories.headline: Nvidia posts record $81.6B Q1 revenue, up 85%, adds $80B buyback as AI demand stays 'parabolic'

key_facts.fact: Nvidia reported record revenue of $81.6 billion for the quarter ended April 26, 2026, up 85% year-over-year and up 20% sequentially
key_facts.excerpt: NVIDIA today reported record revenue for the first quarter ended April 26, 2026, of $81.6 billion, up 20% from the previous quarter and up 85% from a year ago.

key_facts.fact: Record Data Center revenue was $75.2 billion, up 92% year-over-year; Data Center networking revenue was a record $14.8 billion, up 199% year-over-year
key_facts.excerpt: Record Data Center revenue of $75.2 billion, up 92% from a year ago ... Data Center networking revenue was a record $14.8 billion, up 199% from a year ago and up 35% sequentially.

key_facts.fact: GAAP net income rose 211% year-over-year to $58.3 billion, with diluted EPS of $2.39, up 214%
key_facts.excerpt: Net income | $58,321 ... 211% ... Diluted earnings per share | $2.39 ... 214%

key_facts.fact: Nvidia's board approved an additional $80.0 billion share repurchase authorization and raised the quarterly dividend from $0.01 to $0.25 per share
key_facts.excerpt: the Board of Directors approved an additional $80.0 billion to the Company's share repurchase authorization, without expiration. NVIDIA is increasing its quarterly cash dividend from $0.01 per share to $0.25 per share

key_facts.fact: Nvidia guided to $91.0 billion in Q2 fiscal 2027 revenue and said it is 'not assuming any Data Center compute revenue from China' in that outlook
key_facts.excerpt: Revenue is expected to be $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%. NVIDIA is not assuming any Data Center compute revenue from China in its outlook.

key_facts.fact: CEO Jensen Huang framed the quarter around AI infrastructure expansion
key_facts.excerpt: “The buildout of AI factories — the largest infrastructure expansion in human history — is accelerating at extraordinary speed,” said Jensen Huang, founder and CEO of NVIDIA.

sources.title: NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for First Quarter Fiscal 2027
Nvidia reports Q1 net income up 211% to $58.3B, raises Q2 forecast to $91B; Huang says demand is 'parabolic'

stories.headline: Huang says Nvidia has 'largely conceded' China's AI chip market to Huawei, tells investors to 'expect nothing'

key_facts.fact: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said the company has 'largely conceded' China's AI chip market to Huawei as US export restrictions reshape the AI semiconductor landscape
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said the company has “largely conceded” China's artificial intelligence chip market to Huawei ... “We've really largely conceded that market to them,” he added.

key_facts.fact: Huang praised Huawei's strength, saying Nvidia has 'evacuated' the Chinese market
key_facts.excerpt: “Huawei is very, very strong. They had a record year, they'll likely, very likely, have an extraordinary year coming up, and their local ecosystem of chip companies are doing quite well, because we've evacuated that market.”

key_facts.fact: Huang said Nvidia told investors to 'expect nothing' regarding approvals to sell advanced chips into China
key_facts.excerpt: Huang ... saying Nvidia had told investors to “expect nothing” regarding approvals to sell advanced chips into the country.

key_facts.fact: China once accounted for at least one-fifth of Nvidia's data center revenue but the company has been effectively shut out since the Trump administration required an export license in April
key_facts.excerpt: The Chinese market once accounted for at least one-fifth of Nvidia's data center revenue. However, the company has effectively been shut out of the market after the Trump administration told Nvidia in April that it would need a license to export chips to China

key_facts.fact: The comments came alongside Nvidia's blockbuster Q1 earnings report
key_facts.excerpt: Huawei and other local chipmakers are filling the gap left by Nvidia's exit, with Huang admitting: “We've really largely conceded that market to them.”

sources.title: Nvidia says it has 'largely conceded' China's AI chip market to Huawei
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says company has 'largely conceded' China chip market to Huawei

stories.headline: AMD pledges over $10B in Taiwan to scale advanced packaging for next-gen AI chips

key_facts.fact: AMD announced more than $10 billion in investments across the Taiwan ecosystem to expand partnerships and scale advanced packaging manufacturing for AI infrastructure
key_facts.excerpt: AMD today announced more than $10 billion in investments across the Taiwan ecosystem to expand strategic partnerships and scale advanced packaging capabilities for AI infrastructure.

key_facts.fact: AMD is working with Taiwan-based ASE and SPIL to develop next-generation wafer-based 2.5D bridge interconnect (EFB) technology to support its 6th Gen EPYC 'Venice' CPUs
key_facts.excerpt: AMD is collaborating with Taiwan-based ASE and SPIL, as well as other industry partners, to develop and qualify next-generation wafer-based 2.5D bridge interconnect technology. EFB architecture increases interconnect bandwidth and improves power efficiency, supporting “Venice” CPUs.

key_facts.fact: AMD said it qualified the industry's first 2.5D panel-based EFB interconnect with packaging partner PTI
key_facts.excerpt: The focus is on developing EFB-based 2.5D packaging technology, which will significantly improve interconnect bandwidth and efficiency for the new 6th Gen AMD EPYC CPUs, codename “Venice.”

key_facts.fact: AMD's Helios rack-scale platform, using 'Venice' CPUs and Instinct MI450X GPUs, is on track for multi-gigawatt deployments beginning in the second half of 2026
key_facts.excerpt: AMD Helios rack-scale platform with “Venice” and AMD Instinct MI450X GPUs on track for multi-gigawatt deployments beginning 2H 2026

sources.title: AMD Announces More Than $10 Billion in Taiwan Ecosystem Investments to Accelerate AI Infrastructure
AMD Announces Over $10 Billion Investment in Taiwan to Enhance AI Infrastructure and Advanced Packaging Capabilities

stories.headline: AMD prices Ryzen AI Halo desktop at $3,999 and unveils Ryzen AI Max 400 chips to undercut Nvidia

key_facts.fact: AMD said its Mac Mini-sized Ryzen AI Halo PC will start at $3,999 with Ryzen AI Max 300 CPUs, with pre-orders beginning in June
key_facts.excerpt: AMD announced that it will start at $3,999 with Ryzen AI Max 300 CPUs ... Preorders start in June.

key_facts.fact: AMD positions the Halo as a local-compute alternative to monthly cloud AI fees and a direct competitor to Nvidia's DGX Spark AI PC, which now costs $4,699
key_facts.excerpt: AMD is directly competing with NVIDIA's DGX Spark AI PC, which now goes for $4,699 after launching at $4,000 ... AMD positions the Halo as a cost-effective alternative to paying high monthly AI computing fees.

key_facts.fact: The Halo carries a 50 TOPS NPU, a Radeon GPU with 40 compute units and 128GB of unified memory, and can run Windows or Linux
key_facts.excerpt: the Ryzen AI Halo can run either Windows or Linux ... The Halo has a 50 TOPS NPU and a Radeon GPU with 40 compute units ... 128GB of unified system memory

key_facts.fact: AMD unveiled new Ryzen AI Max 400 chips led by the 16-core AI Max+ Pro 495 (5.2GHz boost, 55 TOPS NPU, up to 192GB unified memory), available in Q3 2026
key_facts.excerpt: they'll be led by the AI Max+ Pro 495, a 16-core chip with a 5.2GHz boost speed, 55 TOPS NPU ... support up to 192GB of unified memory ... Ryzen AI Max 400 chips will be available in the third quarter of 2026.

sources.title: AMD prices its Ryzen AI Halo PC at $3,999, unveils Ryzen AI Max 400 chips

stories.headline: SpaceX S-1 reveals Anthropic pays xAI $1.25B/month for compute; xAI to buy $2.8B more turbines

key_facts.fact: SpaceX's IPO filing revealed Anthropic will pay xAI $1.25 billion per month through May 2029 for compute, after Anthropic secured the entire output of the 300-megawatt Colossus 1 data center near Memphis
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic will be paying xAI $1.25 billion per month through May 2029, with a discounted rate for the first two months as xAI completes its ramp-up. All told, the deal could bring xAI over $40 billion in revenue.

key_facts.fact: Either side can terminate the contract with 90 days' notice; SpaceX said the deal lets it 'monetize unused compute capacity'
key_facts.excerpt: The terms of the deal allow either side to terminate the contract with 90 days' notice. ... “allows us to monetize unused compute capacity in our infrastructure.”

key_facts.fact: Anthropic said it is expanding the partnership and will scale up GB200 capacity in xAI's Colossus 2 data center throughout June
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic is paying SpaceX $1.25 billion per month through May 2029 ... Anthropic says it is expanding the deal to include Colossus 2.

key_facts.fact: The filing disclosed xAI will buy another $2.8 billion of turbines over three years, including a $2 billion deal for 'mobile gas turbines' — the type the NAACP is suing it over
key_facts.excerpt: the company said its xAI division will buy another $2.8 billion worth of turbines for its AI infrastructure over the next three years. One deal, worth $2 billion, is specifically for “mobile gas turbines,” the kind that it's currently being sued over.

key_facts.fact: xAI has been granted permits for 15 turbines at its Memphis site but was operating 46 as of a few weeks ago
key_facts.excerpt: So far, xAI has been granted permits for 15 turbines. As of a few weeks ago, it was using 46.

sources.title: Anthropic will pay xAI $1.25B per month for compute
Musk's xAI is being sued over its data center generators — now it's buying $2.8B more

stories.headline: Samsung reaches last-minute wage deal, averting 18-day memory-chip strike amid global shortage

key_facts.fact: Samsung Electronics management and its largest labor union reached a last-minute wage deal on May 20, a day before a planned strike at the world's largest memory chipmaker
key_facts.excerpt: Management and labor of Samsung Electronics Co. on Wednesday reached an agreement on a wage deal a day before a planned strike at the world's largest memory chipmaker.

key_facts.fact: The agreement includes a 6.2% wage increase plus a new 'special semiconductor performance-based bonus' tied to AI chip earnings, set at 10.5% of business performance earnings without a cap
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung will allocate a special semiconductor performance bonus equivalent to 10.5 percent of business performance earnings, without a cap.

key_facts.fact: The planned 18-day strike (May 21–June 7) by nearly 48,000 union members is suspended, with the tentative deal put to a member vote from Friday through May 27
key_facts.excerpt: The planned 18-day strike by nearly 48,000 union members will be suspended, while the tentative agreement is put to a vote by members from Friday through May 27.

key_facts.fact: Industry estimates suggested an 18-day strike could have cut global DRAM supply by 3–4% and NAND flash by 2–3%, deepening an ongoing memory shortage
key_facts.excerpt: More than 47,000 Samsung Electronics workers were gearing up for an 18-day strike ... raising concerns around the already constrained production of memory chips amid the ongoing shortage.

key_facts.fact: Samsung accounts for roughly one-third of the global DRAM market, and chips make up about 35% of South Korea's exports
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung accounts for roughly one-third of the global dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) market ... outbound chip shipments account for roughly 35 percent of South Korea's exports

sources.title: Samsung wage deal eases fears of economic shock, global chip supply disruption
Samsung Electronics management, labor reach wage deal ahead of planned strike
Samsung has a tentative deal with workers to avoid a memory chip strike

stories.headline: Chinese humanoid maker Robot Era raises ~$140M A+ round led by Geely Capital

key_facts.fact: Embodied-AI robotics company Robot Era (Xingdong Jiyuan) completed an A+ round of about 1 billion yuan (roughly $140 million), led by Geely Capital
key_facts.excerpt: 具身智能机器人公司「星动纪元」完成十亿元A+轮融资。本轮融资由吉利资本领投。 (Embodied-AI robotics company Robot Era completed a 1 billion yuan A+ round, led by Geely Capital.)

key_facts.fact: Co-investors include BAIC Industrial Investment, the Beijing AI Industry Investment Fund and the Beijing Robotics Industry Development Investment Fund
key_facts.excerpt: 北汽产投、北京市人工智能产业投资基金、北京机器人产业发展投资基金联合投资。

key_facts.fact: Founded about two years ago, Robot Era counts Alibaba, Haier Capital, Lenovo, Geely and BAIC among backers and is the only embodied-AI company in which Tsinghua University holds equity
key_facts.excerpt: 成立两年 ... 包括阿里巴巴、海尔资本、联想、吉利、北汽等等。 ... 「星动纪元」也是清华大学唯一持股的具身智能企业。

key_facts.fact: The company's 2025 commercialization orders exceeded 500 million yuan, with deep partnerships with Geely, Renault, SF Express, TCL, Haier and Lenovo; its largest single logistics order was nearly 50 million yuan
key_facts.excerpt: 该公司2025年的商业化订单超过5亿元 ... 在物流领域，「星动纪元」最大的一笔订单近五千万。

key_facts.fact: Robot Era self-develops more than 95% of its components and products span the L7 full-size bipedal robot and its end-to-end VLA embodied model ERA-42
key_facts.excerpt: 零部件自研比例超过 95% ... 面向工业领域的全尺寸双足机器人星动 L7 ... 端到端VLA具身模型ERA-42

sources.title: Robot Era completes 1 billion yuan A+ round led by Geely Capital, commercialization orders top 500 million yuan
